Sun & Moon series · FLI

Forbidden Light

Released May 4, 2018 · 150 cards

Expanded

Forbidden Light is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on May 4, 2018. Its main set has 131 cards, plus 19 secret rares numbered beyond the set (150 in total). It includes 120 Pokémon, 27 Trainer and 3 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

47 illustrators worked on Forbidden Light. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (25), Ken Sugimori (8), Toyste Beach (8), kirisAki (5), Megumi Mizutani (5), Akira Komayama (4), Anesaki Dynamic (4), kawayoo (4).
